articles.title: Musk accuses Zelenskyy of lying about Starshield restrictions in Ukraine
articles.description: Elon Musk was asked about Zelenskyy claims over the Starshield network, and he said, "I don't want to blow your mind, but Zelenskyy is not always truthful."

articles.title: Bitcoin carry trades could beat Treasury bills in 2027, Sygnum predicts
articles.description: Sygnum predicts that Bitcoin carry trades may offer higher returns than Treasury bills in 2027, following a sharp drop in funding rates that made the strategy less compelling in 2026.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Ethereum block builders received the most in a $3.4 million vault hack, data shows
articles.description: An automated trading bot copied the attack on K3 Capital's sBOLD vault, taking more than half the funds and paying most of its proceeds to get its transactions processed first.

articles.title: Senators warn GENIUS Act rules could push stablecoin firms toward federal oversight
articles.description: The lawmakers urged Treasury to extend safe harbor protections to stablecoin issuers in states expected to establish qualifying regulatory frameworks before January 2028.

articles.title: Binance hackers stole 192 tokens across 11 networks, court docs show
articles.description: Stablecoins accounted for at least $3.46 billion of the $6.3 billion stolen, while the hackers also took memecoins, tokenized gold and gaming tokens.

articles.title: Bitcoin miner that sold its last BTC warns it may run short of cash for $1.2 billion AI deal
articles.description: Hyperscale Data needs another $74.8 million to complete its Michigan data center project, even after selling its remaining bitcoin and raising fresh debt.

articles.title: 'Parasite' backer and other South Korean media, gaming and travel stocks rally on China trade deal
articles.description: Korean media, gaming and travel stocks surged on hopes of greater access to China.

articles.title: CZ says tokenized Anthropic is coming to BNB Chain on IPO day
articles.description: Changpeng Zhao says Anthropic-linked tokens from bStocks, Ondo and xStocks will hit BNB Chain on day one of the AI giant’s Nasdaq debut. This follows a $500 million pre-IPO rush that comes with notable fine print.

articles.title: Musk says Jensen Huang is irreplaceable, regrets midterm spending

articles.title: Anthropic IPO raises over $81 billion in largest offering on record, topping SpaceX

articles.title: Fed officials saw October rate hold as a ‘close call,’ minutes show
articles.description: The latest FOMC minutes suggest greater appetite for higher rates than the Fed’s 10–2 vote indicated, with markets now pricing in a December hike.

articles.title: One of the world's most contested seas is proving too much for Asia's leaders to resolve

articles.title: Kash Patel skips House hearing after Mar-a-Lago gala with $50,000 access

articles.title: Palo Alto inks $4.5 billion deal for AI startup Applied Compute, shares pop 7% on earnings
articles.description: Palo Alto Networks has been steadily acquiring companies to capitalize on demand for cyber tools to fight AI.

articles.title: Big bets against AI debt, from CoreWeave to Oracle and the Mag 7, could soon hit the ETF market
